policy_name: Algorithmic Content Optimization Engine — Video Rating Policy
description: Evaluation policy for AI-generated YouTube Shorts dance videos. Score each criterion, compute weighted total, and map to a distribution tier.

auto_fail_conditions.label: Standing Start
auto_fail_conditions.description: Frame 1 shows a static or near-static pose before movement begins.
auto_fail_conditions.result: Score overridden to 0. Video must be regenerated.

auto_fail_conditions.label: No On-Screen Text
auto_fail_conditions.description: No text overlay present in the first 2 seconds.
auto_fail_conditions.result: Hook and Engagement Bait categories both score 0.

auto_fail_conditions.label: Duration Violation
auto_fail_conditions.description: Video duration is below 13 seconds or above 20 seconds.

auto_fail_conditions.label: No Trending Audio
auto_fail_conditions.description: Audio track is not sourced from the approved trending audio pool.

hook_quality.description: Evaluates the first 1.5 seconds. The hook must arrest scroll behavior immediately.

criteria.label: Peak Motion in Frame 1
criteria.description: The very first frame must show the dancer mid-peak movement, not a lead-in or static pose.

evaluation.pass: Frame 1 captures a dynamic, high-energy motion pose.
evaluation.fail: Frame 1 is static, fading in, or shows a pre-movement stance.

criteria.label: High-Contrast Background
criteria.description: Background must be visually stark (black, white, or single-color neon) to isolate the dancer from competing feed visuals.

evaluation.pass: Background is a single solid or neon color with no visual noise.
evaluation.partial: Background has minimal texture or gradient. Deduct 4 points.
evaluation.fail: Background is busy, realistic, or indistinct from the dancer.

criteria.label: Pattern Interrupt Element
criteria.description: A visual or textual element in the first 1.5s that is unexpected or dissonant enough to break scroll momentum.

evaluation.pass: On-screen text or visual effect is bold, large, and appears within 0–1.5 seconds.
evaluation.partial: Text appears but is small or low contrast. Deduct 3 points.
evaluation.fail: No pattern interrupt element present in first 1.5 seconds.

criteria.label: No Introductory Build-Up
criteria.description: Zero tolerance for fade-ins, title cards, logo animations, or any non-motion frame before the dance begins.

evaluation.fail: Any non-dance frame appears before motion begins.

retention_and_loop.description: Evaluates video length and loop engineering to maximize rewatch multiplier.

criteria.label: Duration Sweet Spot
criteria.description: Video must be between 13–15 seconds to maximize forced-rewatch retention percentage above 100%.

criteria.label: Seamless Loop — Final Frame Match
criteria.description: The final frame must visually blend into frame 1. Dancer's body position and camera angle should be within 5 degrees of identical to enable an invisible loop.

evaluation.pass: Final frame and frame 1 are visually near-identical. Loop is imperceptible.
evaluation.partial: Minor positional mismatch but the loop is smooth enough to pass. Deduct 4 points.
evaluation.fail: Final frame is visually disconnected from frame 1. Hard cut on loop is visible.

criteria.label: Consistent Pacing — No Dead Zones
criteria.description: No moment in the video should have static or low-energy movement. Energy must be uniform or escalating throughout.

evaluation.pass: All frames contain visible, dynamic motion.
evaluation.partial: One brief low-energy transition present. Deduct 3 points.
evaluation.fail: Two or more static or low-energy segments detected.

engagement_bait.description: Evaluates whether the video mechanically forces the viewer to open the keyboard, which loops the video in the background.

criteria.label: Typed-Response Question Present
criteria.description: An open-ended, polarizing, or completion-style question must be embedded as on-screen text. Emoji-only responses are a failure signal — the question must demand a typed answer.

evaluation.pass: Question is specific and demands a typed response (e.g., 'Name a song harder than this', 'Rate 1–10', 'Drop the next song below').
evaluation.partial: Question is vague or could be answered with one tap/emoji. Deduct 5 points.
evaluation.fail: No question present, or question is yes/no answerable.

criteria.label: Question Visibility
criteria.description: The comment bait text must be legible throughout the full video duration, not just a brief flash.

evaluation.pass: Text is present from 0:00 to end, large, bold, high-contrast.
evaluation.partial: Text appears for less than 70% of duration or is small. Deduct 2 points.
evaluation.fail: Text appears for less than 3 seconds or is illegible.

criteria.label: Polarization Potential
criteria.description: The question or concept should have a divisive or competitive angle that triggers disagreement-based comments.

evaluation.pass: Question invites comparison, ranking, or opinion (e.g., 'harder than this', 'better than X').
evaluation.fail: Question is neutral or generic (e.g., 'What do you think?').

visual_production.description: Evaluates the AI-generation quality and visual composition of the video.

criteria.label: Dancer Isolation
criteria.description: Dancer must be the sole visual focal point. No environmental distractions.

evaluation.pass: Dancer is centered, depth-of-field isolates them from background.
evaluation.partial: Minor background elements visible but not distracting. Deduct 2 points.
evaluation.fail: Background competes with dancer for visual attention.

criteria.label: Reflective or Dynamic Outfit
criteria.description: Outfit must catch and interact with light dynamically to add visual interest within each frame.

evaluation.pass: Outfit is metallic, reflective, or high-contrast with visible light interaction.
evaluation.partial: Outfit is bold but not reflective. Deduct 2 points.
evaluation.fail: Outfit is plain or low-contrast with background.

criteria.label: Render Quality
criteria.description: Video must appear crisp at 4K or equivalent with no AI artifact distortion visible in motion.

evaluation.pass: No visible generation artifacts, blur, or morphing distortion during peak motion.
evaluation.partial: Minor artifacts in non-focal areas only. Deduct 2 points.
evaluation.fail: Visible AI distortion or morphing artifacts on dancer body or face.

audio_alignment.description: Evaluates whether the audio track is sourced from the current trending audio pool and is rhythmically matched to the dance.

criteria.label: Track Source — Trending Pool
criteria.description: Audio must come from the approved trending audio pool (current Billboard Hot 100 or recent major album release).

evaluation.pass: Track is in the current Billboard Hot 100 top 20 or from an album released within the last 30 days.
evaluation.partial: Track is Hot 100 but ranked 21–50. Deduct 1 point.
evaluation.fail: Track is not trending or is unlicensed original audio.

priority_tracks.title: The Fate of Ophelia
priority_tracks.note: Dominant Spotify streams — peak hype window

avoid.title: Janice STFU
avoid.reason: Controversy-adjacent — unpredictable comment section suppression risk

criteria.label: Beat Sync
criteria.description: Dance movement peaks must align with audio beat drops or rhythmic accents.

evaluation.pass: Dancer motion is visibly synchronized with at least 3 distinct beat hits.
evaluation.fail: Dance is out of sync or audio is purely background with no choreographic alignment.

metadata.description: Evaluates title, description, and hashtag strategy for algorithmic discoverability.

criteria.label: Comment Bait Mirrored in Title
criteria.description: The title must echo the on-screen question to reinforce the engagement loop in the browse feed.

evaluation.pass: Title includes the comment bait question or a direct variant.
evaluation.fail: Title is generic with no engagement prompt.

criteria.label: Hashtag Mix Ratio
criteria.description: Must follow the 3-niche / 4-broad / 3-audio-anchor ratio to balance discoverability pools.

evaluation.pass: At least 3 niche tags (#aidance, #aiart), 4 broad tags (#shorts, #viral, #fyp, #trending), and 1+ audio-anchor tag (artist name).
evaluation.fail: All hashtags are broad only or audio-anchor only.

required_hashtag_categories.audio_anchor: dynamic — must match whichever track from approved_audio_pool is used

criteria.label: Description CTA
criteria.description: Description must contain a call-to-action that reinforces the comment bait question.

evaluation.pass: Description contains a line directing viewers to comment (e.g., 'Drop the song you want next below').
evaluation.fail: Description is empty or contains no CTA.

scoring_engine.formula: sum of all earned points across all categories
scoring_engine.auto_fail_override: If any auto_fail_condition is triggered, the relevant category scores 0 regardless of individual criterion scores.

post_rating_action_map.score_85_to_100: Publish immediately. Post follow-up optimized video within 48 hours to compound Honeymoon Phase.
post_rating_action_map.score_65_to_84: Fix lowest-scoring category before publishing. Do not waste Honeymoon Phase on a sub-optimal video.
post_rating_action_map.score_0_to_64: Do not publish. Regenerate video using ACOE prompt with auto_fail corrections applied first.
